title: Leveraging the Potential of Prompt Engineering for Hate Speech Detection in Low-Resource Languages
findings: The paper uses examples of anti-religious hate speech (e.g., attacks on Hindu temples in Bangladesh) to motivate the need for detection. The datasets used contain religiously-motivated hate speech. It was found that using a 'Religious Extremist' role-prompt significantly improved hate speech detection accuracy, suggesting that contextually relevant roles enhance model performance on this task.
